summary: GO-LIVE manual test pack for the Providers (Healthcare Providers) module of Saranam India Health Care. Covers the providers list (search, specialization filter, status filter, refresh, card-grid render, row click to detail, empty/loading/error states), provider create/edit form (all fields, required-field and format validation, signature upload, inline AddOptionDialog for specializations and the Manage Specializations dialog), provider detail (info sections, stats, schedule preview tab, appointments tab, edit, soft-delete/deactivate confirmation), and the Provider Schedule Manager (per-day working hours, slot duration, capacity, apply-to-all, bulk save). Also covers all REST endpoints derived from api/providers.js and backend/app/providers/routes.py, JWT/session handling (401 auto-refresh then redirect to /login), non-existent provider id handling, and data-integrity checks that a newly created provider/specialization flows into list and scheduling selectors. Cases are written to be executed manually in a browser at https://saranam.fieldintel.ai and recorded Pass/Fail in Excel.
in_scope: Providers list page (/providers): initial load, search by name/license/HPR ID, specialization filter, status filter (All/Active/Inactive), refresh button, provider card grid, count display, card click and View Details navigation, loading state, empty state, error alert

Create provider (/providers/new) via ProviderForm: all fields, required-field validation (full_name, specialization), email/phone/postal/duration format, signature image upload (PNG/JPG, max 500KB client), save success/failure, cancel/back
Edit provider (/providers/:id/edit): prefilled form, update, status (Active/Inactive) change
AddOptionDialog: inline add new specialization, min-length validation, duplicate/error handling, auto-select after add
Manage Specializations dialog: list specializations, soft-delete a specialization, empty list message

Provider detail (/providers/:id): status/teleconsult badges, basic info, contact info, bio, stats, Appointments tab, Schedule preview tab, Manage Schedule navigation, Edit, Deactivate with browser confirm
Provider Schedule Manager (/providers/:id/schedule): load/default schedule, toggle days, start/end time, slot duration, capacity per slot, Apply to All Active Days, bulk save, success/error feedback
REST API endpoints for providers, specializations, departments, schedule, availability, appointments, signature upload, quick-create, unknown-provider
Auth/session: protected routes require login; 401 triggers token refresh then redirect to /login on failure
Data integrity: new provider appears in providers list and is selectable in scheduling/visit-assignment selectors; new specialization appears in filter and form dropdowns
out_of_scope: Appointment creation/edit business logic (covered by Scheduling module PRV defers to that pack); only the embedded AppointmentList/AppointmentDetailsModal rendering within provider detail is sanity-checked
Department filter and Add Department dialog (commented out in current UI, endpoints exist but are not wired to any screen)
Bulk import flow and quick-create / unknown-provider UI (no provider-module screen invokes them; API-only coverage included)
Prescription PDF rendering of the uploaded signature (covered by prescription/visit module)
Login screen itself, role/permission management UI (Users module)
Cross-browser/device matrix beyond a single primary desktop browser unless explicitly noted
roles_and_access: All provider routes (/providers, /providers/new, /providers/:id, /providers/:id/edit, /providers/:id/schedule) are wrapped in the authenticated layout in App.jsx and require a valid login (JWT access_token in localStorage). There is no provider-specific role/permission gate beyond authentication, so any logged-in user may view, create, edit, deactivate providers and manage schedules. Every backend endpoint is decorated with @jwt_required(), so an unauthenticated or expired-token request returns 401. The axios response interceptor in api/client.js intercepts a 401, attempts a one-time token refresh using the refresh_token; if refresh succeeds the original request is retried, if it fails (or no refresh_token) all tokens/user are cleared from localStorage and the browser is hard-redirected to /login.

api_endpoints.purpose: List/search providers. Query params from UI: limit (hardcoded 100), search, specialization, is_active. Backend reads q, specialization, department, is_active(default true), page, per_page(max 100), sort_by(full_name), sort_order(asc). Returns {providers,total,page,per_page,total_pages}. 200 success, 500 on error.
Get all specializations. Returns {specializations:[...]}. 200; 500 on error.
Add a custom specialization. Body {name}. 201 created; 400 if name missing or invalid (ValueError, e.g. duplicate); 500 on error.
Soft-delete (deactivate) a specialization by name (URL-encoded, path converter). 200 message; 404 if not found; 500 on error.
Get all departments. Returns {departments:[...]}. 200; 500 on error. (UI not wired.)
Add a custom department. Body {name}. 201; 400 if missing; 500. (UI not wired.)
Get one provider by UUID. 200 with provider object; 404 if not found; 500 on error. Non-UUID path segment is not matched by <uuid:...> route and yields 404 (Flask routing).
Create a provider. Body = full form data. 201 created; 400 on ValueError (validation); 500 on error.
Update a provider. Body = form data. 200 updated; 404 if not found; 400 on ValueError; 500 on error.
Soft-delete / deactivate a provider. 200 {message}; 404 if not found; 500 on error.

Upload signature image (multipart, field 'signature'). Accepts image/png|jpeg|jpg|webp. 200 {signature_image,storage}; 404 if provider missing; 400 if no file / wrong mime / empty / >5MB; Cloudinary or base64 storage.
Get provider appointments. Params from_date,to_date,status,page,per_page. Returns {appointments,total,page,per_page,total_pages}. 200; 500 on error.
Get weekly schedule. Returns {schedules:[{day_of_week,day_name,start_time,end_time,slot_duration,...}]}. 200.
Create/update single schedule entry. Body = schedule object. (Helper createSchedule; not used by Schedule Manager which uses bulk.)
Bulk create/replace weekly schedules. Body {schedules:[7 day objects]}. Used by Schedule Manager Save. Success returns created schedules; error returns {error}.
Update schedule for a specific day (0-6). (Helper updateDaySchedule; not directly wired to a button.)
Delete schedule for a specific day (0-6). (Helper deleteDaySchedule.)
Available slots for a date. Params date(required),duration(optional). (Helper getAvailability; consumed by scheduling.)
Available slots for a date range. Params from_date,to_date,duration. (Helper getAvailabilityRange.)
Quick create provider for bulk import. Body {full_name(required),specialization,phone,email,bulk_import_session_id}. 201; 400 if full_name missing. (API-only.)
Get or create 'Unknown Provider' placeholder for bulk imports. 200. (API-only.)

test_data_setup: A valid login account with access to the platform (any authenticated user works; no special role required). Have valid email + password ready.

At least 5 existing active providers with varied specializations (e.g., Dr. Anjali Rao - Palliative Medicine, Dr. Vikram Nair - Oncology, Nurse Lakshmi Iyer - Home Care Nursing) and at least 1 inactive provider for status-filter checks.
At least one provider WITH a defined weekly schedule and one provider WITHOUT any schedule (to test empty schedule preview + Setup Schedule).
At least one provider WITH stats/appointments and one freshly created provider with zero appointments.
A second browser/incognito profile or a way to clear localStorage tokens to exercise 401/session redirect.
Sample signature images: a valid PNG ~50KB, a valid JPG ~200KB, an oversized PNG > 500KB, and a non-image file (e.g., a .pdf or .txt renamed) for negative upload tests.

A note of one valid existing provider UUID (copy from a detail URL) and one syntactically-valid-but-nonexistent UUID (e.g., 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) plus one clearly malformed id (e.g., 'abc123').
Realistic India test data: phone +91-9876543210, email test.doctor@saranam.in, postal code 560001, city Bangalore, state Karnataka, license FM-2026-001, HPR ID HPR-123456, qualification MBBS, MD.

test_cases.title: Providers list loads with default Active filter on first visit

Wait for the providers to load.

A brief loading spinner ('Loading providers...') may appear, then a responsive card grid of ACTIVE providers (status filter defaults to 'Active'). The count line 'Showing N provider(s)' matches the number of cards. Each card shows full_name, specialization, an Active badge, and any of license/email/phone present.

test_cases.title: Add Provider button (header) opens create form

test_cases.title: List endpoint parameter contract (UI limit/search vs backend per_page/q)
test_cases.preconditions: Valid JWT. DevTools open.
steps: Trigger a search on /providers and capture the GET /providers request.
Compare params sent (limit, search, specialization, is_active) with the backend-supported params (q, specialization, department, is_active, page, per_page, sort_by, sort_order).
test_cases.expected_result: Document the contract: the UI sends 'search' and 'limit' while the backend route reads 'q' and 'per_page'. Verify on the live backend whether 'search'/'limit' are honored (the service signature may differ from the route). If search appears to not filter server-side, raise as an integration defect. Response is always {providers,total,page,per_page,total_pages} with 200.

test_cases.title: Specializations and departments GET endpoints return arrays
test_cases.preconditions: Valid JWT.
test_cases.expected_result: Specializations returns 200 {specializations:[...]}. Departments returns 200 {departments:[...]} (used only via the API; the department UI is disabled).

test_cases.title: Add specialization without name returns 400
test_cases.preconditions: Valid JWT.
test_cases.expected_result: 400 with {error:'Specialization name is required'}.

test_cases.title: Delete non-existent specialization returns 404
test_cases.preconditions: Valid JWT.
test_cases.expected_result: 404 with {error:'...'} (ValueError mapped to 404).

test_cases.title: Provider appointments endpoint pagination/filters
test_cases.preconditions: Valid JWT. Provider with several appointments across statuses/dates.
test_cases.expected_result: 200 {appointments,total,page,per_page,total_pages}; results respect status/date filters; per_page is capped at 100.

test_cases.title: Schedule Manager loads existing schedule pre-filled
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. Provider WITH a defined schedule.
steps: Open /providers/{id}/schedule for a provider with a saved schedule.
test_cases.expected_result: Header shows 'Schedule Manager', provider name and an Active/Inactive badge. Days that have a saved schedule are toggled ON with their start/end times (HH:MM), slot duration and capacity prefilled; other days are OFF.

test_cases.title: Default schedule for provider without one (Mon-Fri active)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. Provider WITHOUT any schedule.
steps: Open /providers/{id}/schedule for a provider with no schedule.
test_cases.expected_result: Monday–Friday (day values 0–4) default to active with 09:00–17:00, 30-min slots, capacity 1; Saturday and Sunday default inactive showing 'Provider is not scheduled to work on this day.'

test_cases.title: Toggle a day on/off reveals/hides its time and config fields
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager.
steps: Toggle an active day (e.g., Wednesday) OFF.
test_cases.expected_result: Turning a day ON reveals start/end time inputs, slot Duration select, Capacity/Slot input and 'Apply to All Active Days'. Turning a day OFF hides those and shows the 'not scheduled' italic note; the row styling changes (active rows highlighted).

test_cases.title: Edit working hours, slot duration, and capacity for a day
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager with Monday active.
steps: Set Duration = 45 min from the dropdown.
test_cases.expected_result: Inputs accept the values and reflect them in the row state. Duration dropdown offers 15/20/30/45/60. Capacity input is bounded min 1 max 10 (and defaults to 1 if cleared).

test_cases.title: Apply to All Active Days copies settings
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. Schedule Manager with multiple active days.
steps: Click 'Apply to All Active Days' on the Monday row.
test_cases.expected_result: All OTHER active days copy Monday's start_time, end_time, slot_duration and max_appointments_per_slot. Inactive days are unchanged; the source day (Monday) is unchanged.

test_cases.title: Save schedule (bulk) succeeds with success badge
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager with valid days configured.
steps: Configure at least Mon–Fri with valid times.
test_cases.expected_result: Button shows 'Saving...' then a green 'Saved Successfully' badge appears (auto-hides after ~3s). POST /providers/{id}/schedule/bulk is sent with {schedules:[7 day objects]} including inactive days (is_active=false). Re-opening the detail Schedule tab shows the saved active days.

test_cases.title: Save with end time before start time (conflict/validation)
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager.
steps: Set Monday Start 17:00 and End 09:00 (end before start).
test_cases.expected_result: Save should fail validation. Backend returns an error and the red Alert shows err.response.data.error or 'Failed to save schedules. Please check your inputs.' NOTE: there is no client-side end>start guard, so confirm the backend rejects it; if it is silently accepted, raise as a data-integrity defect.

test_cases.title: Save error path shows red alert
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager. Ability to force the bulk request to fail.
test_cases.expected_result: A red Alert with an AlertCircle icon shows the API error or fallback message; no success badge; saving spinner clears; user can retry.

test_cases.title: Back to Provider Profile navigation
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager.
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to /providers/{id}; any unsaved schedule edits are discarded (no save-on-leave).

test_cases.title: Schedule round-trip data integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. On the Schedule Manager.
steps: Set a distinctive schedule (e.g., Tue 11:00–13:00, 15 min, cap 4; all others off).
Also open the detail Schedule tab.
test_cases.expected_result: After reload only Tuesday is active with exactly 11:00–13:00, 15-min slots, capacity 4; all other days inactive. Detail Schedule tab matches. Values persisted with no drift.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated access to provider routes redirects to login
test_cases.preconditions: Not logged in (clear localStorage tokens).
test_cases.expected_result: Each protected route redirects to the login screen (auth guard). After logging in, navigating to /providers works normally.

test_cases.title: Expired access token triggers refresh then retry
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in with a valid refresh_token but an expired/invalid access_token.
steps: Replace access_token in localStorage with an expired/garbage value (keep a valid refresh_token).
test_cases.expected_result: The first GET /providers returns 401; the interceptor calls POST /auth/refresh once, stores a new access_token, and retries the original request which then succeeds. The list renders without a forced logout.

test_cases.title: Failed refresh clears tokens and hard-redirects to /login
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. Set an invalid refresh_token so refresh fails.
steps: Set both access_token and refresh_token to invalid values.
Open /providers and trigger an API call.
test_cases.expected_result: 401 -> refresh attempt fails -> localStorage access_token/refresh_token/user are removed and the browser hard-redirects to /login (window.location.href).

test_cases.title: Newly created provider appears in the list immediately
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in.
steps: Create a new active provider 'Dr. Sunil Pillai' (PRV-015 flow).
test_cases.expected_result: The new provider is returned by the list query and shown as an active card with its specialization.

test_cases.title: New provider is selectable in scheduling / visit-assignment selectors
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. A newly created active provider exists.
steps: Go to the Scheduling / appointment creation (or visit assignment) screen.
Search for the newly created provider.
test_cases.expected_result: The new provider appears as a selectable option in provider/visit-assignment dropdowns (since active providers are listed via the same providers API). Selecting it associates the appointment/visit with that provider.

test_cases.title: New specialization propagates to list filter and form dropdown
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. A specialization newly added via AddOptionDialog (PRV-023).
steps: After adding 'Lymphedema Care', go to /providers and open the Specialization filter.
Open /providers/new and open the Specialization dropdown.
test_cases.expected_result: The new specialization appears as an option both in the list page filter and in the create/edit form dropdown (both call GET /providers/specializations on mount).

test_cases.title: Deactivated provider removed from active scheduling selectors
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. An active provider with no future commitments that can be deactivated.
steps: Open the scheduling / visit-assignment provider selector that lists active providers.
test_cases.expected_result: The deactivated provider no longer appears in active-provider selectors (is_active=true list), confirming the soft-delete is reflected downstream. It still exists under the Inactive filter on the list page.

test_cases.title: Edit form load failure shows error alert
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in. Ability to force GET /providers/{id} to fail when opening edit.
test_cases.expected_result: Destructive Alert 'Failed to load form data. Please try again.' is shown; the form is not usefully prefilled. (Specializations may still load independently.)
